## Checklist
- [ ] `./aixun test` passes (paste the last line):
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test that fails without the change
- [ ] Wire bytes: unchanged / **changed** (explain, attach a hardware report)
- [ ] Hardware tested: no / yes (station, versions, host):
- [ ] `docs/DEVELOPMENT_REPORT.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated where relevant
- [ ] `./aixun check-publish` is clean (no firmware, logs, serial numbers)
